title: Nginx misconfiguration after upgrade
alert: Users see error messages on product pages while the home page loads.

truth.root_cause: The newly deployed nginx 1.28.0 version contains a misconfigured upstream that causes it to fail to connect to the API container, returning 502 errors for API requests.
truth.fix: Roll back the web container to the previous nginx 1.27 image, then verify that product pages load correctly.
